records.source: I hope Jas and Marnie are doing alright without me.#$e#I'm not too worried... Jas is old enough now to take care of the animals on her own.
records.translation: Sana ay maayos sina Jas at Marnie kahit wala ako.#$e#Hindi ako gaanong nag-aalala... Malaki na si Jas para alagaan nang mag-isa ang mga hayop.

records.source: You know what? I think I've lost some weight since moving in with you.$6
records.translation: Alam mo? Sa tingin ko ay nabawasan ang timbang ko mula nang lumipat ako rito kasama mo.$6

records.source: Here... take this.[346 174 303 305 215]#$e#I bought some of those a while ago and they're almost expired...
records.translation: Heto... kunin mo ito.[346 174 303 305 215]#$e#May binili akong ilan sa mga iyan dati at malapit nang masira ang mga iyon...

records.source: Buhh... I don't feel like being productive today.
records.translation: Bleh... Wala akong ganang maging kapaki-pakinabang ngayon.

records.source: @, should I do something useful today?... or just nap forever?
records.translation: @, may kapaki-pakinabang ba akong gagawin ngayon?... o matutulog na lang habambuhay?

records.source: Hmm... seems like a good night to microwave a few pizza rolls.#$e#Some people like to cook them in the oven, but it just takes too long for me. Plus I like that squishy texture.$h
records.translation: Hmm... mukhang magandang gabi para magpainit ng ilang rolyo ng pizza sa microwave.#$e#Gusto ng ilan na lutuin ang mga iyon sa hurno, pero napakatagal niyon para sa akin. Isa pa, gusto ko ang malambot at mamasa-masang tekstura.$h

records.source: Charlie's doing well.$8
records.translation: Maayos ang kalagayan ni Charlie.$8

records.source: The tip-tappa-tip of the rain takes me to a different time... a different place.
records.translation: Dinadala ako ng tip-tapa-tip ng ulan sa ibang panahon... sa ibang lugar.

records.source: I guess... if I had some pants I might've gone outside today... but, nah.
records.translation: Siguro... kung may pantalon ako, baka lumabas sana ako ngayon... pero, huwag na.

records.source: I like gloomy weather, but I feel kinda bad for the hens.
records.translation: Gusto ko ang makulimlim na panahon, pero medyo naaawa ako sa mga inahin.

records.source: Tip-tappa-tip-tappa-tip... I'm starting to feel thirsty.$6
records.translation: Tip-tapa-tip-tapa-tip... Nauuhaw na ako.$6

records.source: Buh... sometimes life feels like a slow, gray blur... know what I mean?
records.translation: Bleh... minsan ay parang mabagal at kulay-abong kalabuan ang buhay... alam mo ang ibig kong sabihin?

records.source: Hey. Take this... I put a bit too much in the microwave. [195 215 206]#$e#Sorry if it's squishy.
records.translation: Uy. Kunin mo ito... Naparami ang inilagay ko sa microwave. [195 215 206]#$e#Pasensiya na kung malambot at mamasa-masa.

records.source: Do me a favor... when I pass away, use my dust to fertilize some corn for the hens.
records.translation: Pabor naman... kapag namatay ako, gamitin mo ang abo ko upang patabain ang mais para sa mga inahin.

records.source: *smooch*... Mmm, it tastes like someone's been nibbling on pizza rolls.$6
records.translation: *tsup*... Mmm, parang may kumakain-kain ng mga rolyo ng pizza.$6

records.source: I may keep to myself a lot, and I may seem unhappy sometimes... but I do appreciate all the work you do. I'm a lucky guy.$6
records.translation: Madalas akong mapag-isa, at mukha akong malungkot kung minsan... pero talagang pinahahalagahan ko ang lahat ng ginagawa mo. Masuwerte akong lalaki.$6

records.source: I'm just gonna have a couple more beers before closing my eyes for the night.
records.translation: Iinom lang ako ng ilan pang serbesa bago ko ipikit ang mga mata ko ngayong gabi.

records.source: If... If only... ah, I was just thinking back on the glory days, when I played gridball on the varsity team.$6#$b#Now I'm old and weak, though...
records.translation: Kung... Kung sana... ah, inaalala ko lang ang maluwalhati kong mga araw noong naglalaro ako ng gridball sa pangunahing koponan ng paaralan.$6#$b#Pero ngayon, matanda at mahina na ako...

records.source: Ughh... *gurgle*... I feel a little bloated... oof... too much Joja all-purpose dipping sauce.
records.translation: Ughh... *kumalam*... Parang medyo kinakabag ako... aray... naparami ang sarsang pansawsaw ng Joja na panglahat.

records.source: Buh... I wish I was six inches taller and a whole lot smarter...#$e#You like me for who I am? I still have a hard time understanding that...
records.translation: Bleh... Sana ay mas matangkad ako nang anim na pulgada at mas matalino nang husto...#$e#Gusto mo ako dahil sa kung sino ako? Nahihirapan pa rin akong maunawaan iyon...

records.source: I spent all day watching TV and now my legs feel like soft dough. Guess I'll have to take it easy until tomorrow.
records.translation: Buong araw akong nanood ng telebisyon at ngayon ay parang malambot na masa ang mga binti ko. Mukhang kailangan kong magpahinga hanggang bukas.

records.source: I didn't sleep well last night so I'm hoping this fresh air will get the juices flowing.#$e#What juices, you ask? Heh... you're weird.$h
records.translation: Hindi ako nakatulog nang maayos kagabi kaya umaasa akong padadaluyin ng sariwang hanging ito ang mga katas.#$e#Anong mga katas, tanong mo? Heh... kakaiba ka.$h

records.source: Sometimes I stop and realize that I'm nothing more than a bag of juicy, squishy flesh.#$e#But hey... that's just fine... what's life, anyway?$h
records.translation: Minsan ay humihinto ako at napagtatantong isa lang akong supot ng makatas at malambot na laman.#$e#Pero uy... ayos lang iyon... ano ba ang buhay?$h

records.source: When I stop and think about it... I'm in a good place. My life is pretty nice.$6
records.translation: Kapag humihinto ako at pinag-iisipan iyon... nasa mabuti akong kalagayan. Maganda naman ang buhay ko.$6

records.source: Ooohh... my tongue is swollen from eating too many pepper poppers.$s
records.translation: Ooohh... namamaga ang dila ko dahil naparami ang kinain kong Pritong Siling may Keso.$s

records.source: Hey, @. You were sleeping like a baby so I slipped out of bed and went for a morning walk around the farm. Everything looks fine.
records.translation: Uy, @. Natutulog kang parang sanggol kaya dahan-dahan akong bumangon at naglakad sa palibot ng bukid kaninang umaga. Mukhang maayos ang lahat.

records.source: It's weird, when I was younger I swore I'd never have a kid. I wonder what happened to me?$6
records.translation: Kakaiba, noong mas bata ako ay nanumpa akong hindi ako magkakaanak kailanman. Ano kaya ang nangyari sa akin?$6

records.source: Let's make sure to give %kid1 lots of eggs... Baby's gotta grow those legs!
records.translation: Tiyakin nating mabigyan ng maraming itlog si %kid1... Kailangang patibayin ng sanggol ang mga binting iyan!

records.source: Papa Shane reporting for duty...$6#$e#Buh... I've become corny in my old age.
records.translation: Narito na si Papa Shane para tumupad sa tungkulin...$6#$e#Bleh... Naging baduy na ako sa pagtanda.

records.source: I already fed the kids two bowls of pizza puffs cereal. They'll be full for a while.
records.translation: Napakain ko na ang mga bata ng tig-dalawang mangkok ng cereal na malulutong na bolang pizza. Mabubusog sila nang matagal.

records.source: I'll be honest... two kids is enough for me.
records.translation: Magtatapat ako... sapat na sa akin ang dalawang anak.

records.source: Ugh... %kid2 is being a little brat today. Must've gotten that from me...
records.translation: Ugh... Medyo salbahe si %kid2 ngayon. Siguro ay nakuha niya iyon sa akin...

records.source: *Sigh*... If only we could send the kids off to Joja work-camp for a season...#$e#I'm just kidding.$h
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... Kung maipapadala lang sana natin ang mga bata sa kampo-paggawa ng Joja nang isang panahon...#$e#Nagbibiro lang ako.$h

records.source: *Sniff*... *sniff*... mmm... what's that wonderful fragrance you're wearing? Eau de pepperoni?$6
records.translation: *Singhot*... *singhot*... mmm... ano ang napakabangong pabangong suot mo? Eau de pepperoni?$6

records.source: You're a lot better-looking than me, you know that?$h
records.translation: Di-hamak na mas maganda ang hitsura mo kaysa sa akin, alam mo ba iyon?$h

records.source: The name 'Shane' means 'Gift from Yoba'... What a joke.
records.translation: Ang pangalang “Shane” ay nangangahulugang “Regalo mula kay Yoba”... Napakalaking biro.

records.source: I'm in a great mood today... The Tunnelers won big last night.$h
records.translation: Napakaganda ng pakiramdam ko ngayon... Malaki ang panalo ng Tunnelers kagabi.$h

records.source: Hey, if I ever seem cranky, just ignore it. I get in weird moods sometimes, but it's not about you... okay?
records.translation: Uy, kung mukha man akong bugnutin, huwag mo lang pansinin. Kakaiba ang timpla ng pakiramdam ko minsan, pero hindi iyon dahil sa iyo... ayos?

records.source: Ah... life on the farm sure beats working at Joja. That place was disgusting.$h#$e#You think it was depressing out front? Kid, you should've seen the back room...
records.translation: Ah... di-hamak na mas maganda ang buhay sa bukid kaysa sa pagtatrabaho sa Joja. Kasuklam-suklam ang lugar na iyon.$h#$e#Akala mo ay nakapanlulumo na sa harap ng tindahan? Bata, dapat nakita mo ang silid sa likod...

records.source: Ah... this is the life. No responsibilities, Tunnelers game tonight, fridge stocked with all the goodies a guy could need.$h
records.translation: Ah... ito ang buhay. Walang pananagutan, may laro ng Tunnelers ngayong gabi, at punô ang pridyider ng lahat ng masasarap na kakailanganin ng isang lalaki.$h

records.source: I don't really feel like doing work today. Maybe I'll see what's on TV.
records.translation: Wala talaga akong ganang magtrabaho ngayon. Baka tingnan ko kung ano ang nasa telebisyon.

records.source: Huh... You're wondering why I have this goofy grin on my face? You really have a short memory span, don't you? *blush*$h
records.translation: Huh... Iniisip mo kung bakit nakangisi akong parang hangal? Napakadali mo talagang makalimot, hindi ba? *namula*$h

records.source: Oh, do you need something from me? Sorry, I'm kind of busy at the moment.
records.translation: Ah, may kailangan ka ba sa akin? Pasensiya na, medyo abala ako ngayon.

records.source: Why don't you tell me about your day when we're in bed tonight? I'm kind of busy right now...
records.translation: Bakit hindi mo ikuwento sa akin ang araw mo kapag nasa kama na tayo mamayang gabi? Medyo abala ako ngayon...

records.source: Working at Joja was a drag, but at least I got to interact with people occasionally.
records.translation: Nakababagot ang pagtatrabaho sa Joja, pero kahit paano ay nakikisalamuha ako sa mga tao paminsan-minsan.

records.source: What, you want me to clean the dishes? I'll do it... eventually...
records.translation: Ano, gusto mong hugasan ko ang mga pinggan? Gagawin ko iyon... kalaunan...

records.source: Are we doing okay on money? I don't want to have to go back to work at Joja.
records.translation: Ayos ba tayo sa pera? Ayaw kong bumalik sa pagtatrabaho sa Joja.

records.source: If you need to go see your friends in town, go ahead. I'm happy in the company of the TV and a couple of tall boys.
records.translation: Kung kailangan mong puntahan ang mga kaibigan mo sa bayan, sige lang. Masaya na ako kasama ang telebisyon at dalawang malaking lata ng serbesa.

records.source: Ugh... clean, clean, clean. Sweep, sweep, sweep. Bathe. Cook. Make the bed... Oh, well. Life's alright.
records.translation: Ugh... linis, linis, linis. Walis, walis, walis. Maligo. Magluto. Ayusin ang kama... Hay naku. Ayos naman ang buhay.

records.source: Look, I just want to be alone. Why don't you go outside and do your own thing for a while?
records.translation: Makinig ka, gusto ko lang mapag-isa. Bakit hindi ka lumabas at gawin muna ang gusto mo?

records.source: What do you want? You sound like Marnie on one of her bad days. Go away.$a
records.translation: Ano ang gusto mo? Para kang si Marnie kapag masama ang timpla niya. Umalis ka.$a

records.source: Farm-life is actually really boring. What am I doing here?$s
records.translation: Talagang napakanakababagot ng buhay sa bukid. Ano ang ginagawa ko rito?$s

records.source: Yeah... *hic* ... Sure, honey. Whatever you say... *hic*
records.translation: Oo... *sinok* ... Sige, mahal. Anuman ang sabihin mo... *sinok*

records.source: I'm going to go out today, alright?
records.translation: Lalabas ako ngayon, ayos lang?

records.source: Sorry if I'm sweaty... That was quite a walk... Buh, I'm out of shape.$6
records.translation: Pasensiya na kung pawis ako... Mahabang lakaran iyon... Bleh, wala ako sa kundisyon.$6

records.source: Ooo... my throbbing head. How many did I have last night?
records.translation: Ooo... kumikirot ang ulo ko. Ilan ba ang nainom ko kagabi?

records.source: The egg festival is probably my favorite... you know how I am, I go crazy for anything to do with chickens.$h
records.translation: Paborito ko marahil ang Pista ng Itlog... alam mo naman ako, nababaliw ako sa anumang tungkol sa mga manok.$h

records.source: Oh, right. It's the flower dance tomorrow. Hey, if it makes you happy, I'm happy.
records.translation: Ah, tama. Sayaw ng Bulaklak bukas. Uy, kung masaya ka, masaya rin ako.

records.source: I like seeing all the tropical plants this time of year. The valley gets so lush.
records.translation: Gusto kong makita ang lahat ng tropikal na halaman sa panahong ito ng taon. Napakalago ng lambak.

records.source: I might fast until the luau tomorrow. I need the ol' bag to be empty so I can fill it with piping hot soup.$h
records.translation: Baka mag-ayuno ako hanggang sa Luau bukas. Kailangang walang laman ang lumang tiyan para mapunô ko ito ng napakainit na sopas.$h

records.source: What are your plans for the fall? I'm going to try and incorporate more wine into my diet.
records.translation: Ano ang mga plano mo para sa taglagas? Susubukan kong isama ang mas maraming alak sa diyeta ko.

records.source: Hmm... I might have to buy a few cases of pumpkin ale to celebrate the season...$6
records.translation: Hmm... Baka kailangan kong bumili ng ilang kahon ng ale na kalabasa upang ipagdiwang ang panahon...$6

records.source: I'll be helping Marnie with the animals at tomorrow's fair, like usual. You should just kick back and have some fun.$6
records.translation: Tutulungan ko si Marnie sa mga hayop sa perya bukas, gaya ng lagi. Magpahinga ka lang at magsaya.$6

records.source: I'm starting to really feel my age... and I'm not comfortable with that at all.
records.translation: Nagsisimula ko nang talagang maramdaman ang pagtanda ko... at hindi ako natutuwa roon.

records.source: Any big plans this winter? I'll probably end up watching a lot of TV and just hanging out around the house.
records.translation: May malalaki ka bang plano ngayong taglamig? Malamang ay manonood ako ng maraming telebisyon at tatambay lang sa bahay.

records.source: Well, another year gone by... I look a little older, but that's about all.$6
records.translation: Aba, lumipas na naman ang isang taon... Mukha akong medyo mas matanda, pero iyon lang naman.$6
